description: Armed Security Guard has to guard designated premises and people by manning the first tier of protection aided by appropriate security devices/ equipment and by timely and efficient use of firearms. The core responsibility includes guarding against theft, criminal acts, emergencies, fire, and other contingencies.
awardingBodyName: Management and Entrepreneurship and Professional Skills Council

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Apply health and safety practices at the workplace
Apply principles of professional practice at the workplace
Support cash and valuables in in-transit operations
Deal with security situations warranting use of Firearms
Observe safety norms while handling firearms
Provide guarding services to people, property and premises
Perform security tasks in accordance with basic security practices

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.REMARKS: Training in subjects stipulated in Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act-2005 and other applicable skills. Holder of valid arms license
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELEVANTSPECIALIZATION: prior experience with Armed Forces/ Paramilitary forces/ Agniveer
